concept_sheet.prompt: Concept art sheet for a video game first-person view model: one RIGHT hand and forearm, cut off just below the elbow, no body. Style: a late-1990s 3D PC fantasy game, hand-painted texture look on a chunky, low-poly-friendly silhouette with readable forms. Not modern photoreal, no glossy rendering. Plain neutral mid-grey background. Lay out four views in a 2x2 grid: top-left "relaxed" (back of the hand, fingers slightly curled); top-right "open" (palm up, fingers open); bottom-left "grip" (holding a smooth fist-sized carved stone orb as a held magic item); bottom-right "cast" (seen from the wearer's own eyes in first person, hand raised, index and middle fingers extended forward). Small plain labels under each view with exactly those words. Consistent design across all four views. 1536x1024 landscape. Character: a hardened human hunter-assassin. A strong, weathered human hand with a ruddy, sun-reddened complexion, prominent knuckles and veins, and short plain fingernails (normal human nails, no claws). Forearm wrapped in a quilted, diamond-stitched dark red-brown leather bracer with dark seams and a small bronze buckle, plus a few twine wraps at the wrist. Colour palette sampled from the original character textures: skin highlight #dd8a89, skin mid #ae5d5c, skin shadow #793b3b and #5a2727, leather #3f2321 and #331516, seams #1c1010 and #0d0b0b, buckle dull bronze.
concept_sheet.note: palette hex values were sampled locally from the original character skin; no original art was sent to any service

meshy_input_image.prompt: 3D modelling reference image of a single RIGHT hand and forearm, cut cleanly just below the elbow, nothing else in the image. Neutral rigging rest pose: palm facing down, wrist straight, all four fingers straight and slightly spread with a clear gap between every finger, thumb relaxed out to the side at about 45 degrees. Viewed from above at a three-quarter angle so all five fingers and the thumb are fully visible and separated. Centred, filling most of the frame. Plain pure white background, soft even studio lighting, no cast shadow, no text, no labels. Style: hand-painted texture look of a late-1990s 3D fantasy game on simple, smooth, low-poly-friendly forms. Character: a hardened human hunter-assassin. A strong, weathered human hand with a ruddy, sun-reddened complexion, prominent knuckles and veins, and short plain fingernails (normal human nails, no claws). Forearm wrapped in a quilted, diamond-stitched dark red-brown leather bracer with dark seams and a small bronze buckle, plus a few twine wraps at the wrist. Colours: skin highlight #dd8a89, skin mid #ae5d5c, skin shadow #793b3b, leather #3f2321 and #331516, seams #1c1010, buckle dull bronze. Square 1024x1024.
